title: Norman's Neighborhood: 14-year-old takes heroic action during triple homicide that took mothers life - NewsBreak
text:
By Gary Burton Jr. ,
7 hours ago
LITTLE ROCK, Ark. – For 14-year-old Raquel from Little Rock, the June 2019 scene on West 16 th Street in Little Rock lives forever in her head and heart.
“It’s absolutely amazing to me that she is as strong as she is,” said Officer Tommy Norman who met Raquel just two months ago.
Norman’s Neighborhood: North Little Rock beauty school helps instill confidence in students At 8 years old, Raquel was outside playing with two other kids when a man approached her mother’s door and eventually went inside. Raquel says she made eye contact with him.
“When I looked him in his eyes, I didn’t know what was wrong with him, but I felt something was fixing to happen,” Raquel said.
She was correct. Moments later, inside the home, the man proceeded to kill Raquel’s cousin, Sydne Bolden, her mother, Dontriece Hughes, and a friend of her mother that was there.
As Raquel heard the commotion outside, she reacted.
“I had got the other two kids, and I told them we had to go and they was like ‘Why?’” Raquel recalls. “I told them something bad just happened.”
With fear, Raquel says she found a lady who let her and the other kids inside her home.
“I had looked out the window and I saw the man in the truck looking for us, and she was like, just get down on the ground,” Raquel said.
Norman’s Neighborhood: Officer Norman shares story of 19-year-old Matthew’s miracle battle after heart failure Raquel’s grandmother, Christal, said she eventually “found out later on that he got in the truck and went looking for Raquel to kill her.”
With tears in her eyes, Christal says this is the first time she’s spoken about that day.
She says her soul left her body when she arrived at the scene of the triple homicide.
“To me, it was a story out of a movie,” Officer Norman said.
In just a short time of knowing this family, Norman has already impacted them in ways they couldn’t have imagined.
By sharing their story on his social media platform, Christal has gained a virtual sister from Wisconsin who has helped her with her heartbreak.
“It’s like I’ve known her for a long time,” Christal said.
Christal says they plan to meet soon.
And Officer Norman plans to be around for a long time as well
Norman’s Neighborhood: Officer Norman helping 19-year-old overcome trauma of mother’s death He says he wants to help Raquel with her therapy, as it’s still a tough battle 6 years later.
“I’m not going anywhere; you are stuck with me,” Norman said to Raquel.
